falsifiable_hypothesis: A worker process or session lost mid-flight leaves no false completion and the unit is resumable from immutable input.
injection_method: for each of the nine states in the live order a real child worker reaches that state, performs the durable work belonging to it, and is killed with SIGKILL (returncode -9 confirmed in every case); the parent then executes a genuine resumption with a fresh lease, fresh bytes, a fresh commit and a fresh ingestion

fault_classes.observed_behaviour: only the CREATED event existed; the scanner classified the unit DISPATCH; no completion, no ingestion, chain clean, capsule intact; a fresh worker resumed from the capsule to PARENT_INGESTED with a matching read-back
CREATED and LEASED events survived; classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT; the resumption took a new lease with an advanced fence and reached PARENT_INGESTED with zero errors
the chain ended at RUNNING and verified cleanly; classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT; resumption reached PARENT_INGESTED
the checkpoint event survived the loss with its hash intact; classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT; resumption reached PARENT_INGESTED
bytes existed only in the worktree with no commit; classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT; resumption committed fresh bytes and reached PARENT_INGESTED
the staged byte count was recorded in the chain but nothing was durable in Git; classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT; resumption reached PARENT_INGESTED
the verified hash and byte count survived in the chain while the bytes themselves were still uncommitted; classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT; resumption reached PARENT_INGESTED

the commit was durable and the chain recorded it, yet the scanner still classified RESUME_OR_RERUN_FROM_IMMUTABLE_INPUT with no ingestion record; the resumption produced a second commit and reached PARENT_INGESTED, so no false completion appeared but the first committed result was superseded rather than replayed
the ingested result survived the loss of the session that produced it; the scanner classified the unit AWAIT_COORDINATOR_COMPLETION and no COMPLETED state was ever set by a producer

residual_findings.detail: at the RESULT_COMMITTED kill point the prescribed resumption recomputed and recommitted the result, so the same logical work was performed twice and two commits exist for one unit.
residual_findings.impact: no false completion and no lost custody, but it is a duplicated internal effect and the first committed result is never ingested.

residual_findings.detail: a lost session leaves the chain ending at whatever state it reached; nothing distinguishes 'still running' from 'session gone' without a lease lifetime, and lease lifetime is not enforced.
residual_findings.impact: the recovery action is still correct because it does not depend on liveness, but a coordinator cannot tell how long to wait before transferring.
